fit_note: Explores apps offline and compiles navigation into deterministic replayable commands reused by the VLM agent.
Decides edge-vs-cloud offloading of grounding via perturbed hidden-state divergence; closest to verifying a target before acting.
Competition web-agent system: a11y-first actions, grid visual fallback, history summarisation, fault recovery; no single sub-pattern.
Diffusion model forecasts next symbolic layout per candidate action; rules score anomaly risk to rank actions, plus memory.
Distils an agent trajectory into a judge-refined neuro-symbolic code policy reused across runs of recurring workflows.
Offline single-step GRPO on grounding/action states with spatially refined credit for rule-checked click rewards.
Trains a CUA to interleave GUI actions with shell commands via SFT plus CLI-aware RL rewards.
Replaces the state-merge rule of an outcome-value episodic memory with action-conditioned bisimulation for retrieval.
Retrieves self-explored trajectory priors and trains the agent to follow, partially use or ignore them under drift.
Fine-tuned GUI analyzer scores each executed step; its value gates token-level self-distillation alongside outcome GRPO.
